title: Sensing the skeleton: sensorineural regulation in bone
title_zh: 感知骨骼：骨感受神经调节
abstract: The traditional view of bone tissue as an inert mechanical scaffold has been fundamentally revised over time. Perhaps nowhere is this more clear than in the emerging field of 'skeletal neuroscience', which has revealed the skeleton to be a densely innervated organ that senses and integrates mechanical, immune and metabolic stimuli. Here, we review recent evidence for bidirectional crosstalk between somatosensory neurons and the bone microenvironment, and highlight how techniques such as whole-tissue clearing, genetic tracing and single-cell transcriptomics have mapped osteo-neural interactions with molecular precision. Nerve growth factor (NGF)-TrkA signalling coordinates somatosensory nerve growth and survival during skeletal development and repair, yet the same pathways can drive pathological nerve sprouting, skeletal pain and disease progression in skeletal pathologies ranging from osteoarthritis to heterotopic ossification and bone malignancies. We further discuss neuro-immune-bone interactions, conserved neuroregulatory mechanisms in the skeleton, and emerging neuromodulatory strategies. Finally, we identify topics for future investigation, including the effects of age-related neural decline on the skeleton, sex differences in skeletal innervation and bone pain, and translational gaps between rodent and human biology, that may guide the design of precision medicine interventions.
abstract_zh: 传统上将骨组织视为惰性的机械支架的观点已被根本修订。或许在‘骨感受神经科学’这一新兴领域中，这种修订最为明显，该领域揭示了骨骼是一个密集神经支配的器官，能够感知并整合机械、免疫和代谢刺激。综述了体感神经与骨微环境之间双向对话的最新证据，并阐述了全组织清除、基因系谱追踪和单细胞转录组学等技术如何以分子精度映射骨神经相互作用。骨成长因子（NGF）-TrkA信号协调骨发育和修复过程中的体感神经生长与存活，然而相同的通路也可能驱致病性神经丛生，导致骨痛及骨病进展，包括骨关节炎、异位骨化及骨恶性肿瘤等疾病。进一步讨论了神经-免疫-骨相互作用、骨感受的保守神经调节机制以及新兴的神经调控策略。最后，确定了未来研究的主题，包括与年龄相关的神经衰退对骨骼的影响、骨感受中的性别差异以及啮齿类与人类生物学之间的转化差距，这些可能指导精准医学干预的设计。
